messages:
tay: Noticing a spike on eu-nvme pool `ephemeral-2` from 01:05-01:20 UTC, GPU attaches seeing transient failures.
anil: Logs?
tay: quick sar/iostat snip:
```
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1: 0.00 0.00 20.00 1020.00 320.00 8400.00 8.50 18.40 13.2 1.05 99.8
```
zoe: sounds like cleaner overlap with batch release. Short fix: throttle janitor on that pool and divert new attaches to `reserved-eu` for 10 min.
ops-bot: Applied throttle: janitor.concurrency=4 on pool "ephemeral-2" (canary 8 hosts). Fallback allocation of 10 GPUs to reserved-eu started.
anil: After canary, attach_timeouts down from 22 -> 1 and p95 attach latency back to ~200ms. Good.
tay: Opening ENGINFRA-4950 to track: auto-divert rule + janitor cadence change + cost estimate for reserving 10 GPUs in region.
zoe: I'll draft PR for ionice wrapper and auto-divert alert rules.
tay: Thanks. Monitoring pinned: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/d/attach-health/eu-west3
